title: Mint adoption body
description: A signed adoption of credits created by the old unsigned mint (register row DK95; spec-delta S330). The operator signs and the owner countersigns. It moves `amount` credits of the account's unsigned minted total into its signed total without moving a balance, so a log that already holds unsigned mints can pass `asp credits audit --require-signed` and its replay still reproduces every balance (the replay seeds the unsigned total as it was before any adoption). The history is kept: the unsigned mint stays in the record of what happened. Credits are accounting entries, not money. Chain: none (prev is null).

did.description: The account whose unsigned minted credits are adopted.
